name: agent-office
description: A live office of your Claude Code sessions: a room per project, a critter per session, its subagents beside it, every tool call and context window as it happens. Type /office to open it.

port.title: Bridge port
port.description: Local port the office's bridge listens on (http://127.0.0.1:<port>).

autoStart.title: Start the bridge automatically
autoStart.description: Start the bundled Node bridge when none answers on the port.
